availableMessage: A newer Finledge release is available on GitHub. Review what changed and install it from the official release page.
requiredMessage: This Finledge version is no longer supported. Please install the latest release from GitHub to continue receiving important fixes.
releaseNotes: Bank Services now uses clearer interest and charge categories.
Added Personal Expenses with Bank Flow, Cash Flow, and Combined Overview.
Bank Flow now includes read-only activity from Bank Services and Share Portfolio automatically.
Financial Summary now separates Bank Services, Share Portfolio, Personal Expenses, and overall position analytics.
Settings now includes file management, Import/Export, About, and How To Use sections.
Added automatic, non-destructive data migration from FinLedge 1.1.0.
